title: The Room of Cold Spring
author: Mara Okafor
blurb: Felix Thackeray, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
